full_page.content:
1948, December
The following is a faithful transcription of a printed message composed by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
Dec. 1948
ST. FELIX FRIARY HUNTINGTON, IND.
Dear Friend
Many Thanks for your kind remembrance.
May the Divine Master of the mission- aries bless you and yours! And may you hear His call Today from the tabernacle and from the Crib - as His first Twelve harken- ed to His plea at the well of Jacob:" .. . Pray ye therefore, the Lord of the harvest that He send laborers into His harvest."
THE CAPUCHIN FATHERS
(Signed) Fr. Solanus
The enrollment was taken care of ; God bless you and yours.
Original in Possession of :
Dorothy M. Fletcher 24560 Sherwood Forest Dr. #524 Mt. Clemens, MI. 48043
